summary: The single non-pass feature was a placeholder-only ComboBox (Video Settings) that never surfaced a stable UIA Name, so the structural parity gate could not confirm it and downgraded the scenario to partial. The skill mentioned preserving AutomationProperties only as a buried aside inside the CaptureElement camera example. Promoted it to a prominent, general Critical Rule.

changes.location: New 'Automation discoverability (parity depends on it)' subsection under Critical Rules (after 'Defensive UI', before Post-Migration)
changes.edit: Added a first-class rule: every interactive control must expose a stable UIA name via Header / AutomationProperties.Name / LabeledBy; x:Name alone is not enough; placeholder-only or runtime-populated controls surface no UIA name and MUST get an explicit AutomationProperties.Name. Included a ComboBox before/after example.
changes.general_rule: In WinUI 3, parity/automation checks read the UIA tree; controls without a stable UIA Name (especially placeholder-labelled ComboBox/ListBox/TextBox) are invisible to automation even when visually present. Always give every interactive control an explicit AutomationProperties.Name/Header.

changes.location: Camera preview section, XAML swap note (~line 62)
changes.edit: Rewrote the buried aside to instruct setting an explicit AutomationProperties.Name and cross-linked to the new SKILL.md Automation discoverability rule.
changes.general_rule: Same as above; the camera example now points to the general rule instead of being the only place the guidance appears.

not_changed.reason: dev-agent-slip / false positive: hardware-gated, identical in UWP golden, handler wired, Defensive UI rule already applied. No skill change.

devils_advocate: Could this be scenario-specific (only cameras)? No — placeholder-labelled inputs and runtime-populated lists are a broad UWP idiom (search/filter boxes, settings dropdowns, dynamic lists). Any such control fails UIA discovery on launch, so the rule generalizes. Falsifiable check: a re-run that adds AutomationProperties.Name to the placeholder ComboBoxes should raise Scenario 3 from partial to pass.
